body:
What a fresh box needed by hand today: server/.venv with pip install -e '.[dev]'; web/node_modules;
an Android SDK (cmdline-tools, platforms;android-36, build-tools) and android/local.properties pointing
at it; a JDK with javac; a UTF-8 locale. A bootstrap.sh that does the installable parts, points at the
rest, and ends by running the preflight. Idempotent; never touches keystores or the database.
title: bootstrap.sh: set up a fresh machine to run verify-all.sh in one command
